# 7 two-dim subspaces of GF(2)^5, pairwise intersecting only at 0
subspaces = [
    [0b10000, 0b01000, 0b11000],
    [0b00100, 0b00010, 0b00110],
    [0b00001, 0b10100, 0b10101],
    [0b01100, 0b00011, 0b01111],
    [0b10010, 0b01001, 0b11011],
    [0b10001, 0b00111, 0b10110],
    [0b00101, 0b01011, 0b01110],
]

# Verify pairwise trivial intersection (i.e., the 21 nonzero vectors are all distinct)
allv = []
for s in subspaces:
    allv.extend(s)
assert len(set(allv)) == 21
# Verify each is actually a subspace
for s in subspaces:
    assert s[0]^s[1] == s[2]

# For each week, group golfers by coset of subspace
schedule = [0]*(7*32)
for w, S in enumerate(subspaces):
    Sfull = {0, S[0], S[1], S[2]}
    # Assign group IDs to cosets
    coset_of = {}
    gid = 0
    seen = set()
    for p in range(32):
        if p in seen: continue
        coset = {p ^ s for s in Sfull}
        for q in coset:
            coset_of[q] = gid
            seen.add(q)
        gid += 1
    assert gid == 8
    for p in range(32):
        schedule[w*32 + p] = coset_of[p]

# Verify constraint: no pair together in more than one week
from collections import defaultdict
pair_weeks = defaultdict(int)
for w in range(7):
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for p in range(32):
        groups[schedule[w*32+p]].append(p)
    for g, ps in groups.items():
        assert len(ps) == 4
        for i in range(4):
            for j in range(i+1,4):
                pair_weeks[(ps[i],ps[j])] += 1
assert all(v<=1 for v in pair_weeks.values())
print("Valid!")
print(schedule)
